name: opsmind
description: Live demo: opsmind-demo.vercel.app — multi-tenant AI operations & knowledge platform: hybrid RAG with cited answers (pgvector + full text), KPI dashboards with anomaly detection, EN/RU/AR. Next.js, Express, FastAPI, Postgres. 14-job CI, Helm, Terraform, k6.

paragraphs: A multi-tenant operations and knowledge platform for small businesses: cited AI answers from company documents, KPI dashboards that flag anomalies, and the CI/CD, Kubernetes and observability to run it.

Live demo: opsmind-demo.vercel.app. Click Try the live demo to sign in as a read-only viewer. It is the real stack running serverless: Next.js and the Express API on Vercel, the Python AI service on Vercel, and Postgres + pgvector on Supabase (setup). It is checked daily by the live check. Some networks in Russia block .vercel.app; if it does not open, use the preview below.
Interactive preview: hass-ak.sourcecraft.site/opsmind. It opens instantly with recorded demo data and no server, and it is clearly labelled as a preview (how it works).
features: Tests: 57 API tests (9 of them against a real Postgres), 48 AI-service tests (3 against pgvector) and 6 Playwright browser tests, which run twice: directly and through the Codespaces proxy.
Pipeline: 12 jobs on every pull request and every push to main, from unit tests to a Helm install on kind and a dev-container boot (list).

Load: k6 with 50 virtual users, 0 errors, p95 between 3.1 ms (documents) and 9.4 ms (ask) per endpoint in a typical run, against budgets of 100–800 ms. This uses the offline providers (hash embeddings, extractive…
Retrieval: on 56 labelled questions over 12 documents in English, Russian and Arabic, hybrid search reaches Recall@5 85.7% and MRR@10 0.763 with the offline hash embedder (details).
